description: Apply 1..128 document operations atomically. Supported members are marked batchable in discovery. Every member uses the exact single-operation business schema. Rebuilds and replays candidates in order, validates the final state and commits one history node; any invalid member, cancellation or state conflict leaves the entire workspace unchanged. Returns a process-owned job handle; use job_wait/job_get for the committed state and changed handles. Disconnecting does not cancel execution. Asset layers resolve immutable resources from the captured catalog. Session changes, jobs, project switching, resource writes and nested batches are excluded.

state.description: Opaque state from workspace_inspect or the preceding result. Includes load generation and durable version; history node IDs are not state tokens.

origin.description: Pivot in canvas pixels, y down.

target.description: Target drawable ID or mesh:<ID>; one effect per mesh.
Target drawable ID or mesh:<ID>; one effect per mesh.

enabled.description: Retain recipe while toggling; target/enabled-only updates do not rebake.

horizontal.description: Horizontal material deformation gain; independent of vertical.

vertical.description: Vertical material deformation gain; positive input presses downward.

bulge.description: Virtual arch height; zero disables surface displacement.

press.description: Virtual arch pressure; zero disables surface displacement.

folds.description: Contribution of FOLD guides; no effect without fold guides.

contour.description: Source alpha contour retention: 0 free, 1 retained; no root attachment.

settings.description: Partial update; omitted fields retain saved values or defaults.

enabled.description: Enable this effect's native physics; does not change other groups.

sensitivityX.description: Uniform horizontal mouse-audition gain; explicit poses bypass it.

sensitivityY.description: Uniform vertical mouse-audition gain; explicit poses bypass it.

responseSeconds.description: First region response time in seconds.

transmissionSeconds.description: Following region propagation time in seconds.

transmissionStrength.description: Following region weight; zero removes the spatial split.

from.description: Propagation start [x,y], normalized to the layer; y grows downward.

to.description: Propagation end [x,y]; normalized endpoint distance must be at least 0.05.

motion.description: Partial native timing update; omitted fields retain saved values.

parameters.description: Source X/Y IDs. Empty ID creates a private input. Omitted binding prefers body X/Y.

id.description: Stable guide ID, unique within this effect.

purpose.description: Only FOLD produces local deformation; defaults to FOLD for authoring.

radius.description: Strictly positive influence radius in source pixels.

pitchOnly.description: Apply this fold only to the vertical material channel.

detected.description: Set on lines found by layer_mesh_structure: what the texture analysis took the line for. Omitted for drawn guides. A detected line stays TOPOLOGY until marked FOLD.

points.description: Source-raster [x,y] pixels; consecutive points must differ.

guides.description: Replace guide list; empty list clears local folds. Does not remesh (layer_mesh_structure does).

destination.description: Destination of the same kind; default the target; "auto" pairs the opposite-side object by L/R in its id or name.

key.description: Destination key; default from with reflected parameters flipped about their default and sided parameters (ParamEyeLOpen) swapped for their opposite where the destination binds it or neither, missing destination axes at default.

all_keys.description: Mirror every keyform cell of the target. On one object only the keys on side are sources.

side.description: With all_keys on one object: which side of the first reflected parameter off its default is copied over; default positive.

axis_x.description: Canvas x of the mirror line; default midway between the two objects' rest centers (one object: its own).

reflect.description: Parameters whose value flips about the default; default the symmetric-range ones that are a 2D pad's horizontal axis or end in X or Z.

channels.description: What to carry over: the reflected geometry and channel values as they are at from; default geometry only.

registration_id.description: Required for reference-package assets; immutable absolute placement from asset_register

layer_id.description: Optional stable ID; a unique agent: ID is generated when omitted

semantic_tag.description: SemanticTag enum name in lowercase, for example front_hair

insertion.description: Painter-order placement: top, bottom, above or below a stable layer ID

trim_transparent.description: Crop transparent padding after mapping the complete PNG to canvas units

sensitivity.description: 0 keeps only strong, high-contrast lines; 1 also keeps faint ones. Default 0.5.

min_length.description: Shortest line kept, in source pixels. Default 16.

near_density.description: Vertex spacing along lines, relative to the spacing of the kept edge rows. Default 1.

fill.description: Add vertices between the lines, thinning out away from them. Default false: vertices only on the edge rows and the lines.

far_density.description: With fill, edge length away from lines, relative to the mesh's current inner edge length. Default 1.

bands.description: Straddle each drawn crease with a row on either side and rungs across. Default false: one row on the crease.

kinds.description: Line kinds the mesh follows. Default all three.

max_lines.description: Most lines kept, strongest first. Default 48.

max_vertices.description: The rebuild fails rather than exceed this many vertices. Default 4000.

wrap.description: Wrap topology in mesh units: outline gaps narrower than this are closed; 0 traces the drawn edge

sway.description: For classic_front_hair/classic_back_hair: enable the restored legacy sway (default true).

items.description: rename: name. visibility: visible (mesh/part). move: parent_id (null=root), optional before_id and before_kind for organizational siblings. bind: mesh to deformer parent_id. Deformer move requires space=local, retaining local keys but changing inherited appearance. Mesh bind takes space=local (the same) or space=canvas, which carries the rest mesh, keyforms and blend shapes into the new parent's space so the mesh stays where it shows at the default pose. Organizational moves leave deformation unchanged.

parameter_id.description: Stable Cubism ID. Creation accepts 1-64 ASCII letters/digits/underscores and must start with a letter
Stable Cubism ID. Creation accepts 1-64 ASCII letters/digits/underscores and must start with a letter

inputs.description: What moves the root. Weight is % of the normalized range

scale.description: Parameter units per radian of the segment's swing

segments.description: Root to tip; omitted fields keep the current segment's

segment_count.description: Resize the strand, copying the last segment

normalization.description: Span a full-range input maps to

id.description: Optional new Warp ID for references in later batch members; otherwise allocated once in the candidate.

rows.description: Requested divisions; aligned to parent lattice knots. Inspect the created Warp for effective divisions.

columns.description: Requested divisions; aligned to parent lattice knots. Inspect the created Warp for effective divisions.

fit_local.description: Crop to the grid and additive blend-shape envelope; false retains the full parent domain.

refresh_geometry.description: Generated layers to mesh again from their current pixels (their image was replaced since). Omitted: every layer whose image was replaced; [] keeps all geometry.

meshUnits.description: Unit of every mesh length: DOCUMENT is pixels of the document scaled to a 2048 px long side (same mesh at any resolution); PIXELS is source pixels

meshTrace.description: What mesh outlines are traced from: TEXTURE traces each layer's own pixels (alpha reduced by maximum, up to 4x finer than a mesh unit), so strokes thinner than a canvas pixel stay inside the mesh; CANVAS traces the layer averaged to canvas resolution, as projects saved before it

meshWrap.description: Wrap topology, in mesh units: gaps and notches of a layer's outline narrower than this are closed before tracing, so fine protrusions such as lashes or strand tips share one envelope; 0 (default) traces the drawn edge. Every painted pixel stays inside the mesh. Layers with a layer_mesh override keep their own wrap

turnFade.description: turn group (advanced), in torso lengths, default 0.5

turnCameraDistance.description: depth group (advanced), in torso lengths, default 3.0

leanCameraDistance.description: depth group (advanced), in torso lengths, default 9.0

source_id.description: Raw drawable ID of the mesh to slice; inspect objects first

middle_ids.description: Raw IDs of meshes to place between the rear and new front slices

front_layer_id.description: Optional unique new ID; omit to allocate one

front_mesh_id.description: Optional unique new ID; omit to allocate one

back_layer_id.description: Optional unique new ID; omit to allocate one

back_mesh_id.description: Optional unique new ID; omit to allocate one

glue_id.description: Optional unique new ID; omit to allocate one

names.description: Optional names in rear, front order; otherwise use the source name with back/front suffixes

targets.description: Warp or mesh IDs; meshes sharing a parent are wrapped in one Warp

magnitude.description: Tip travel at ±1 as a fraction of the pinned-edge-to-tip length

lift.description: Extra rise (+) or droop (-) of a bending tip at ±1

softness.description: 0 bends evenly; 1 keeps the root stiff

parallel.description: 0 swings the lattice like one board (tip edge tilts); 1 keeps the tip edge level, columns swaying side by side like separate strands

physics.description: Pendulum override; omit to size it from the target

motions.description: One entry per direction; replaces the flat kind/segments/shape fields

magnitude.description: Tip travel at ±1 as a fraction of the pinned-edge-to-tip length

lift.description: Extra rise (+) or droop (-) of a bending tip at ±1

softness.description: 0 bends evenly; 1 keeps the root stiff

parallel.description: 0 swings the lattice like one board (tip edge tilts); 1 keeps the tip edge level, columns swaying side by side like separate strands

physics.description: Pendulum override; omit to size it from the target

fulcrum.description: Pinned lattice edge; auto hangs tall targets from the top and pivots wide ones on the side nearer the body center

tilt.description: Degrees the swing rectangle turns about the pinned edge's midpoint, for art hanging at a slant; + turns the tip toward the right end of a top/bottom edge or the bottom end of a side edge

offset_along.description: Moves the swing rectangle's pinned edge toward the tip, in pinned-edge-to-tip lengths; what lies behind it stays put

offset_across.description: Moves the swing rectangle along its pinned edge, in edge widths; + toward the right end of a top/bottom edge or the bottom end of a side edge

edits.description: Ordered document edits. Each request uses its single operation's business fields, without state/project_id/request_id. Later edits see earlier candidates. All edits commit together or none do.

request_id.description: Unique request ID. Retry unchanged arguments with this ID to recover the same result; use a new ID for a new attempt.

project_id.description: Current project_id from workspace_inspect; null only when no project is loaded.
